summary.text: Kevin Terrett is the Libertarian candidate for North Carolina State Senate District 10 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which incumbent Benton Sawrey (R) and Pat LeGrand (D) are also running.
He was previously the Libertarian candidate for the North Carolina House of Representatives in District 41 in 2022 and District 26 in 2024.
